question: Which of the following replaced the Planning Commission in 2014?
solution:
The correct answer is __**NITI Aayog**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **NITI Aayog was replaced by the planning Commission**
 
• NITI Aayog__
 __
 
• Its full form is National Institution for Transforming India.
 
• It is the premier policy 'Think Tank' of the Government of India providing both directional and policy inputs.
 
• It was formed on 1 January 2015.
 
• The Governing Council of NITI Aayog comprises The Minister as its Chairman and Chief Ministers of all States and Lt. Governors of Union Territories.
 
• The vice-chairman is Suman Bery and CEO is Parameswaran Iyer.
 
• Its full-time members are V.K. Saraswat, Ramesh Chand, V.K. Paul.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Planning Commission__

 
 
• It was an institution in the Government of India.
 
• It formulated five-year plans.
 
• It was formed on 15 March 1950.
 
• It was dissolved on 17 August 2014 and replaced by the new institution NITI Aayog.
 
• The Prime Minister of India was the ex-officio chairman of the Planning Commission.
